messages:
ialin: FYI we got 3 reports this morning: Next edge sample throws ReferenceError: require is not defined during deploy. Root cause seems to be CJS entry picked up by edge bundlers.
neha.sdk: Yep, edge runtimes don't have require. Our package exports allow CJS so some toolchains pick it.
drew.build: Current package.json uses main->dist/index.cjs and exports with import+require. That confuses some bundlers.
yasmin.docs: Docs issue: quickstart still has CommonJS examples, people paste into edge apps and hit the crash. We should flip to ESM in docs.
neha.sdk: Short mitigation plan: add top-level "types":"dist/index.d.ts" for editor pick-up, change exports so ESM is the default and CJS only under a node condition, and publish a canary.
drew.build: Proposed exports snippet: {".": {"node": {"require": "./dist/index.cjs"}, "import": "./dist/index.mjs", "default": "./dist/index.mjs"}, "./package.json": "./package.json", "./types": "./dist/index.d.ts"} (will validate).
neha.sdk: Also add CI smoke that npm packs the canary into the Next edge sample and runs a vercel build in container to catch regressions.
yasmin.docs: I'll swap examples to ESM and add an "edge debugging" snippet showing how to search for dist/index.cjs in bundles.
ialin: Long-term RFC: ESM-first published package with separate opt-in CJS package. Bigger migration but cleaner.
drew.build: For now I'll publish canary @redwood/inference@canary-esm-default-1 and post tarball here when ready; will add smoke CI.
ci-bot: smoke-tests queued for branch canary/esmfallback. Results will be posted to this thread.
neha.sdk: Thanks team, once canary passes let's push docs + sample updates.
